metadata.short_desc: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance announcement bot
metadata.desc: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance (蓝色协议：星痕共鸣) official announcement bot — announcement list with paging and categories, latest announcement (body typeset by modules: layered module headings with a gold bar, configurable module spacing, plus a browser-width long image typeset locally with Typst), per-group dedup, scheduled auto-push (checked every 5 minutes), and configurable command prefixes. Includes a web panel to manage push targets by group name, change the prefixes and tune the long image.

news_groups.description: Groups that receive scheduled Blue Protocol announcement pushes (group id or unified_msg_origin, multiple allowed)
news_groups.hint: Alternatively send "bp push on" in a group, or tick groups by name in the plugin panel (recommended). Empty means no automatic push.

list_page_size.description: Announcements per page in the list command
list_page_size.hint: How many rows "bp list" returns at once. Use an integer between 1 and 30.

shot_enabled.description: Render announcements as a long image
shot_enabled.hint: When enabled the announcement body is rendered into a long image; when disabled (or on failure) it falls back to the dark card image.

shot_max_height.description: Maximum long-image height (CSS pixels, 0 = no limit)
shot_max_height.hint: Very long announcements are cut at this height and the text message points to the link.

shot_quality.hint: Lower saves bandwidth. Images above 2.5MB are downscaled automatically.

typst_enabled.description: Typeset announcement images with local Typst
typst_enabled.hint: Renders the announcement image with the local Typst compiler — no browser component needed. Falls back to browser screenshots if it fails.

typst_ppi.hint: 144 is the default. Higher density means sharper but larger images; allowed range 72-300.

typst_timeout.hint: Time limit for one typeset run. On timeout the compile process is killed and another renderer takes over.

typst_font_url.hint: Used when the system has no CJK font; the file is cached in the plugin data directory. Leave empty to use the built-in official source.

typst_long_width.hint: Defaults to 1280, the width of a typical browser. Wider means longer lines, so narrower reads better.

typst_long_body_width.hint: Defaults to 1258. Use 0 to follow the canvas width minus the borders automatically.

typst_long_border.description: Border width on both sides of the text (pixels)
typst_long_border.hint: Defaults to 11 — the gap between the text column and the canvas edge.

typst_long_theme.hint: dark (default) or light. Only affects the long image — the share card always uses the dark KV banner.

typst_para_spacing.hint: Defaults to 14 — the blank space between paragraphs.

typst_line_height.hint: Defaults to 1.8; somewhere between 1.2 and 2.5 usually reads best.

typst_module_spacing.hint: Default 34. Blank space above module headings — raise it for a roomier look

command_prefixes.hint: The words that trigger the bot's commands; several are allowed. Spaces are optional (with "blue protocol", blueprotocol works too). Changes apply immediately, no restart needed.

blueprotocol-panel.title: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance — Announcements
blueprotocol-panel.description: Manage push targets by group name, trigger a push manually, browse long images and push records; use the top-right button to switch between English and Chinese.

blueprotocol-panel.title: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance — Announcements
blueprotocol-panel.description: Manage push targets by group name, trigger a push manually, browse long images and push records; use the top-right button to switch between English and Chinese.

bp_latest_dedup.description: Newest announcement (only replies when there is something new, per-group dedup)

bp_push.description: Toggle automatic announcement push for this group (checked every 5 minutes)

bp_reset.description: Clear this group's announcement push record
